items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And the period like, "King Porter's Stomp". And it was the beginning of jazz.

ctx.x: It lacked the sophistication. Is that how you looked on it, too?
Well, yes I wanted music like, like—this was a new period coming in. And the period like, "King Porter's Stomp". And it was the beginning of jazz. Before that it was Dixieland.
